task_description: Replace Pizza King's ~20 individual module purchases with a clean 6-plan package subscription system: a redesigned 'Pricing and Plans' store (route /feature-store) and an owner admin panel (/subscriptions) with full CRUD over plans/prices/features/modules. All purchases flow as package_orders with status history; the owner approves/rejects; approved plans unlock their included modules via the existing LockedRoute/isModuleLocked mechanism.
